rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun tad in accusative singular masculine
compound of gūḍha (hidden) and sadbhāva (true nature), accusative singular
abstract noun from sarvajña with suffix -tva
verb with prefix pra and root jan in middle voice

items.question: What arises when the hidden true nature of that is known?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature produces all-knowingness.
items.inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on prior context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
